response.sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), city_shares AS (SELECT city, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts), overall AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM city_shares) SELECT AVG(s.member_count) AS average_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - o.average_share) AS average_amount_above_overall_average FROM city_shares AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.share > o.average_share;
